methodology: Pipeline simulation: verifier.py loaded directly with mock copy_from_env injecting synthetic result JSONs. Two do-nothing scenarios tested per Lesson 24.

do_nothing_no_export.description: copy_from_env raises FileNotFoundError (agent did nothing, export never ran)

do_nothing_baseline.description: Export ran but all fields at initial state (workspace_found=false, layer_found=false, sld_found=false)

partial_no_layer.description: Workspace and datastore created, but no layer published and no SLD created

full_success.description: All criteria met: regional_atlas workspace + PostGIS datastore + countries layer + continent_colors SLD with 7 rules and 7 distinct fill colors

notes: Score capped below 65 if both layers AND styles are absent. Task tests: workspace creation, PostGIS datastore configuration, layer publishing, SLD authoring with OGC property filters.
verification_method: export_result.sh -> /tmp/continent_thematic_map_result.json -> copy_from_env -> JSON field parsing + inline Python SLD analysis
